b8_stack.fit_subset: FIT85 (n=561) of grouped 85/15 GroupShuffleSplit, seed 999, on full 650
b8_stack.inner_oof: GroupKFold(3) on FIT85; simplex weights maximizing pooled inner-OOF log-score

bundle.cal_subset: CAL15 (n=89), thresholds calibrated here, never refit

deployment_scope_note: Primary deployment restricted to 20-30% hardened porosity because Stage-17 pooled calibration is sound but edge bins under-cover (<15pp 0.77, 30-35pp 0.85, 35+pp 0.62) while the center 20-30pp over-covers (0.94-0.98); GO centrally per Stage-17 handoff. A labelled support-only diagnostic over the original [6.2, 38.02] bounds is reported separately. No post-result relaxation.

integration_into_optimizer.bypass_flag: DISABLE_STAGE17_SUPPORT=1 reproduces old behavior for integration test only; production never sets it
integration_into_optimizer.nominal_feasibility: old Stage-One nominal admissibility AND recipe gate AND phi-in-conf90-HDR AND deployment-domain check
integration_into_optimizer.optimizer_placement: Phase A DE merit penalty (continuous) + Phase C NOMAD PB x3 (recipe/phi/deploy) + Phase D NOMAD PB x3 + Phase B rescreen taxonomy columns
integration_into_optimizer.-penalty_normalization: recipe excess (d-thr)/thr; phi pp distance (/10 in DE merit, raw pp in NOMAD PB); deployment pp outside [20,30] (/10 in DE merit, raw pp in NOMAD PB)

isolation_statement: The single scientific change is the nominal recipe-porosity state-support constraint. Forward LCM-GP, OCSVM/KDE support, paired residual bank, manufacturing uncertainty magnitudes (incl. porosity +-3SD), gradation parameterization, cement objective, reliability target, DE/NOMAD architecture, simplex, targets, and all banks/seeds are unchanged.

recipe_gate.calibration: 95th percentile of grouped 5-fold held-out kth-NN distances on FIT85

recipe_mapping.formula: b_j = A*g_j; x_raw = [r, C, P, S, b1..b6]
recipe_mapping.transforms: log cem; log1p SP/sand/b1..b6; raw w/c; StandardScaler fit on FIT85 only

wording_attainability: The support region is empirical local state support. It is NOT physical attainability, NOT a compaction protocol, NOT a hit probability, and NEVER a manufacturing distribution.
wording_hdr_mass: The 90% HDR mass is a state-support set mass only. It is NOT multiplied into performance reliability (no 81% composite) and NEVER interpreted as probability of attaining the target.
wording_manufacturing: Stage-17 density is NOT sampled as manufacturing uncertainty. The frozen Stage-One manufacturing model (incl. achieved-porosity variation) is unchanged. A fixed-subset MANUFACTURING_CLOUD_EMPIRICAL_SUPPORT_DIAGNOSTIC is descriptive only and never enters R_LCB95.
